```{r}
# 1. Baca data & ganti placeholder ("-", "---", "no input") menjadi NA secara langsung
cropbasics <- read_csv(
  "cropbasics_scrape.csv", 
  col_types = cols(.default = "c")
)
```

```{r}
cat("\n=== 1. HASIL PEMBERSIHAN PLACEHOLDER ('-', '---', 'no input') ===\n")

# Hitung jumlah placeholder sebelum dibersihkan
placeholders <- c("-", "---", "no input")
total_placeholder <- sum(as.matrix(cropbasics) %in% placeholders, na.rm = TRUE)
cat("Total nilai placeholder yang ditemukan dan diubah ke NA:", total_placeholder, "\n")

# Ubah placeholder menjadi NA
cropbasics <- cropbasics %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ ifelse(.x %in% placeholders, NA_character_, .x)))
```

```{r}
cat("\n=== 2. HASIL KONVERSI & RINGKASAN STATISTIK KOLOM NUMERIK ===\n")

num_cols <- c(
  "temp_opt_min", "Temp_Opt_Max", "Temp_Abs_Min", "Temp_Abs_Max",
  "Rain_Opt_Min", "Rain_Opt_Max", "Rain_Abs_Min", "Rain_Abs_Max",
  "pH_Opt_Min", "pH_Opt_Max", "pH_Abs_Min", "pH_Abs_Max",
  "Lat_Opt_Min", "Lat_Opt_Max", "Lat_Abs_Min", "Lat_Abs_Max",
  "Alt_Opt_Min", "Alt_Opt_Max", "Alt_Abs_Min", "Alt_Abs_Max",
  "cycle_min", "cycle_max"
)

# Hapus koma pada ribuan dan konversi ke numeric
cropbasics <- cropbasics %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(num_cols), ~ as.numeric(gsub(",", "", .x))))

# Tampilkan ringkasan statistik (min, mean, max, NA's) beberapa kolom numerik utama
sample_num_cols <- c("temp_opt_min", "Temp_Opt_Max", "Rain_Opt_Min", "Rain_Opt_Max", "pH_Opt_Min", "pH_Opt_Max", "cycle_min", "cycle_max")
print(summary(cropbasics[sample_num_cols]))
```

```{r}
cat("\n=== 3. PERSENTASE KOSONG (NA) KOLOM DENGAN MISSING VALUE EKSTREM ===\n")

cols_high_missing <- c(
  "Al_Toxicity_Opt", "Al_Toxicity_Abs", 
  "Abiotic.toler.", "Abiotic.suscept.", 
  "Introduction.risks.", "Product..system"
)

# Hitung dan tampilkan persentase missing value
missing_pct <- cropbasics %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(cols_high_missing), ~ round(mean(is.na(.x)) * 100, 2))) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "Nama_Kolom", values_to = "Persen_NA (%)")

print(as.data.frame(missing_pct))
```

```{r}
cat("\n=== 4. NILAI UNIK KOLOM KONSTAN (SEBELUM DIHAPUS) ===\n")

cols_constant <- c(
  "Cropping.system", "Subsystem", 
  "Companion.species", "Level.of.mechanization", "Labour.intensity"
)

# Tampilkan nilai unik dari kolom-kolom konstan
unique_vals <- cropbasics %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(cols_constant), ~ paste(unique(na.omit(.x)), collapse = ", "))) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "Nama_Kolom", values_to = "Nilai_Unik")

print(as.data.frame(unique_vals))
```

```{r}
cols_to_drop <- c(cols_high_missing, cols_constant)

cropbasics_clean <- cropbasics %>%
  select(-any_of(cols_to_drop))

# Simpan dataset yang sudah bersih
write_csv(cropbasics_clean, "cropbasics_clean.csv")

cat("\n======================================================================\n")
cat("Pembersihan selesai! Dimensi akhir dataset (Baris x Kolom):", dim(cropbasics_clean)[1], "x", dim(cropbasics_clean)[2], "\n")
cat("File disimpan dengan nama 'cropbasics_clean.csv'\n")
cat("======================================================================\n")
```


```{r}
cat("\n=== 2. HAPUS KOLOM KOSONG (Editor) ===\n")

na_editor_count <- sum(is.na(crop_view$Editor))
cat("Jumlah baris kosong (NA) pada kolom Editor:", na_editor_count, "dari", nrow(crop_view), "baris.\n")

crop_view <- crop_view %>%

cat("Kolom 'Editor' berhasil dihapus dari dataset.\n")
```

```{r}
cat("\n=== 3. PEMBERSIHAN & EKSTRAKSI TEKS ===\n")

# A. EKSTRAKSI FAMILI UTAMA (Kolom Family)
# Mengambil nama famili paling akhir dari hirarki berpemisah titik dua (:)
crop_view <- crop_view %>%
  mutate(Family_Clean = str_extract(Family, "[^:]+$") %>% str_trim())

cat("a) Ekstraksi Kolom Family:\n")
cat("   - Jumlah Famili unik yang diekstrak:", n_distinct(crop_view$Family_Clean, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("   - Contoh hasil ekstraksi 5 baris pertama:\n")
print(head(crop_view %>% select(Family, Family_Clean), 5))
```

```{r}
# B. PARSING SEKSI PADA KOLOM NOTES
# Memecah teks deskripsi panjang menjadi kolom-kolom spesifik menggunakan Regex
crop_view <- crop_view %>%
  mutate(
    Notes_Brief = str_match(Notes, "BRIEF DESCRIPTION\\s+(.*?)(?=\\s+(USES|GROWING PERIOD|COMMON NAMES|FURTHER INF|SOURCES)|$)")[,2],
    Notes_Uses = str_match(Notes, "USES\\s+(.*?)(?=\\s+(GROWING PERIOD|COMMON NAMES|FURTHER INF|SOURCES)|$)")[,2],
    Notes_Growing = str_match(Notes, "GROWING PERIOD\\s+(.*?)(?=\\s+(COMMON NAMES|FURTHER INF|SOURCES)|$)")[,2],
    Notes_Further_Inf = str_match(Notes, "FURTHER INF\\s+(.*?)(?=\\s+(SOURCES)|$)")[,2]
  )

cat("\nb) Parsing Seksi Kolom Notes:\n")
cat("   - Baris terisi pada Brief Description :", sum(!is.na(crop_view$Notes_Brief)), "\n")
cat("   - Baris terisi pada Uses Notes        :", sum(!is.na(crop_view$Notes_Uses)), "\n")
cat("   - Baris terisi pada Growing Period    :", sum(!is.na(crop_view$Notes_Growing)), "\n")
cat("   - Baris terisi pada Further Info      :", sum(!is.na(crop_view$Notes_Further_Inf)), "\n")
```

```{r}
# C. PENANGANAN MISSING VALUE DAN RAPIKAN TEKS (Common_names & Synonyms)
# Mengisi NA dengan "Unspecified" dan membersihkan spasi berlebih
crop_view <- crop_view %>%
  mutate(
    Common_names = ifelse(is.na(Common_names), "Unspecified", str_squish(Common_names)),
    Synonyms = ifelse(is.na(Synonyms), "Unspecified", str_squish(Synonyms))
  )

cat("\nc) Penanganan Missing Value pada Common_names & Synonyms:\n")
cat("   - Sisa NA pada Common_names :", sum(is.na(crop_view$Common_names)), "(Diubah menjadi 'Unspecified')\n")
cat("   - Sisa NA pada Synonyms     :", sum(is.na(crop_view$Synonyms)), "(Diubah menjadi 'Unspecified')\n")
```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. BACA KETIGA DATASET YANG SUDAH DIBERSIHKAN
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Pastikan file-file ini diproses/disimpan dari langkah 1, 2, dan 3 sebelumnya
cropbasics <- read_csv("cropbasics_clean.csv", col_types = cols(.default = "c"))
crop_view  <- read_csv("crop_view_clean.csv", col_types = cols(.default = "c"))
crop_uses  <- read_csv("crop_uses_clean_aggregated.csv", col_types = cols(.default = "c"))

# Pastikan tipe data kunci utama (crop_code) seragam (numeric/integer)
cropbasics <- cropbasics %>% mutate(crop_code = as.integer(crop_code))
crop_view  <- crop_view  %>% mutate(crop_code = as.integer(crop_code))
crop_uses  <- crop_uses  %>% mutate(crop_code = as.integer(crop_code))
```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. PROSES LEFT JOIN BERDASARKAN KUNCI 'crop_code'
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n=== MEMPROSES LEFT JOIN ===\n")

# Merge Pertama: cropbasics + crop_view
df_merged <- cropbasics %>%
  left_join(crop_view, by = "crop_code", suffix = c("", "_view"))

# Merge Kedua: + crop_uses
df_final <- df_merged %>%
  left_join(crop_uses, by = "crop_code")
```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. INSPEKSI HASIL PENGGABUNGAN
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n=== HASIL STATISTIK PENGGABUNGAN ===\n")

cat("1. Jumlah Baris Dataset Utama (cropbasics) :", nrow(cropbasics), "baris\n")
cat("2. Jumlah Baris Setelah Penggabungan        :", nrow(df_final), "baris\n")
cat("3. Jumlah Kolom Total Hasil Penggabungan    :", ncol(df_final), "kolom\n")

# Cek persentase keberhasilan matching data
match_view <- sum(!is.na(df_final$Family_Clean))
match_uses <- sum(!is.na(df_final$Main_use_aggregated))

cat("\nCek Tingkat Keberhasilan Matching (Data Match Rate):\n")
cat("   - Berhasil match dengan crop_view_data :", match_view, "tanaman (", round(match_view/nrow(df_final)*100, 2), "% )\n")
cat("   - Berhasil match dengan crop_uses      :", match_uses, "tanaman (", round(match_uses/nrow(df_final)*100, 2), "% )\n")
```

```{r}

# 4. PRATINJAU DATA HASIL MERGE
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
cat("\n=== CONTOH TAMPILAN BEBERAPA KOLOM HASIL MERGE ===\n")
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# Asumsikan 'df_final' adalah dataset hasil merge kamu
# Jika dibaca dari file: df_final <- read_csv("ecocrop_dataset_final_merged.csv", col_types = cols(.default = "c"))

cat("======================================================================\n")
cat("      REKAPITULASI NILAI NA & 'UNSPECIFIED' PER KOLOM DATASET FINAL    \n")
cat("======================================================================\n\n")

# Hitung jumlah NA dan Unspecified untuk tiap kolom
ringkasan_missing <- df_final %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), list(
    na_count = ~ sum(is.na(.x)),
    unspec_count = ~ sum(str_to_lower(trimws(as.character(.x))) == "unspecified", na.rm = TRUE)
  ))) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = c("Kolom", ".value"),
    names_pattern = "(.*)_(na_count|unspec_count)"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Total_Kosong = na_count + unspec_count,
    Persen_Kosong = round((Total_Kosong / nrow(df_final)) * 100, 2)
  ) %>%
  rename(
    Jumlah_NA = na_count,
    Jumlah_Unspecified = unspec_count
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Total_Kosong))

# Tampilkan semua kolom
print(as.data.frame(ringkasan_missing), row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
# 1. BACA DATASET SMALL SCALE
df <- read_csv("ecocrop_small_scale.csv", col_types = cols(.default = "c"))

# 2. KONVERSI KOLOM MANDATORY & OPTIMAL KE NUMERIK
mandatory_num <- c(
  "Temp_Abs_Min", "Temp_Abs_Max", "temp_opt_min", "Temp_Opt_Max",
  "Rain_Abs_Min", "Rain_Abs_Max", "Rain_Opt_Min", "Rain_Opt_Max",
  "Alt_Abs_Min",  "Alt_Abs_Max",  "Alt_Opt_Min",  "Alt_Opt_Max",
  "pH_Abs_Min",   "pH_Abs_Max",   "pH_Opt_Min",   "pH_Opt_Max"
)

df_clean <- df %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(mandatory_num), ~ as.numeric(.x)))

# 3. PENANGANAN MANDATORY PARAMETERS
df_clean <- df_clean %>%
  # A. Alt_Abs_Min: Isi NA dengan 0 (Permukaan laut)
  mutate(Alt_Abs_Min = ifelse(is.na(Alt_Abs_Min), 0, Alt_Abs_Min)) %>%
  
  # B. Fallback 1: Jika Absolut NA, gunakan nilai Optimal
  mutate(
    Temp_Abs_Min = ifelse(is.na(Temp_Abs_Min), temp_opt_min, Temp_Abs_Min),
    Temp_Abs_Max = ifelse(is.na(Temp_Abs_Max), Temp_Opt_Max, Temp_Abs_Max),
    Rain_Abs_Min = ifelse(is.na(Rain_Abs_Min), Rain_Opt_Min, Rain_Abs_Min),
    Rain_Abs_Max = ifelse(is.na(Rain_Abs_Max), Rain_Opt_Max, Rain_Abs_Max),
    pH_Abs_Min   = ifelse(is.na(pH_Abs_Min),   pH_Opt_Min,   pH_Abs_Min),
    pH_Abs_Max   = ifelse(is.na(pH_Abs_Max),   pH_Opt_Max,   pH_Abs_Max)
  ) %>%
  
  # C. Fallback 2: Jika masih NA, gunakan Median per Category
  group_by(Category) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(mandatory_num), ~ ifelse(is.na(.x), median(.x, na.rm = TRUE), .x))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  
  # D. Fallback 3: Median Global jika 1 Kategori NA semua
  mutate(across(all_of(mandatory_num), ~ ifelse(is.na(.x), median(.x, na.rm = TRUE), .x)))

# 4. VERIFIKASI TIDAK ADA NA DI MANDATORY PARAMETER
cat("=== Sisa NA pada Mandatory Parameters ===\n")
print(colSums(is.na(df_clean[c("Temp_Abs_Min", "Temp_Abs_Max", "Rain_Abs_Min", "Rain_Abs_Max", "Alt_Abs_Min", "Alt_Abs_Max", "pH_Abs_Min", "pH_Abs_Max")])))

# SIMPAN DATASET CLEAN UNTUK MODEL RANKING
write_csv(df_clean, "ecocrop_small_scale_ready_ranking.csv")
cat("\nDataset siap pakai disimpan ke: 'ecocrop_small_scale_ready_ranking.csv'\n")
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

cat("=========================================================\n")
cat(" 🌿 FAO EcoCrop Engine R (6-Var + Multi-Tier Tie-Breaker)\n")
cat("=========================================================\n")

# 1. LOAD DATASET
dataset_file <- if (file.exists("ecocrop_small_scale_ready_ranking.csv")) {
  "ecocrop_small_scale_ready_ranking.csv"
} else if (file.exists("crop_small_scale_clean.csv")) {
  "crop_small_scale_clean.csv"
} else {
  stop("Error: Dataset file not found!")
}

cat(sprintf("-> Loading dataset: '%s'\n", dataset_file))
df_crops <- read.csv(
  dataset_file, 
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE, 
  na.strings = c("", "---", "-", "NA", "N/A", "null")
)

# 2. HELPER FUNCTIONS UNTUK RETRIEVAL DATA
get_val <- function(row, ...) {
  cols <- c(...)
  for (c in cols) {
    if (c %in% names(row) && !is.na(row[[c]]) && row[[c]] != "") {
      return(row[[c]])
    }
  }
  return(NA)
}

get_num <- function(row, ...) {
  v <- get_val(row, ...)
  if (is.na(v)) return(NA)
  return(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(v))))
}

# 3. HELPER METRIK TIE-BREAKER (KAPASITAS & KETAHANAN EKOLOGIS)

# Menghitung jarak relatif input ke titik tengah optimal (0 = paling ideal/stabil)
calc_opt_dist <- function(val, opt_min, opt_max) {
  if (is.null(val) || is.na(val) || is.na(opt_min) || is.na(opt_max)) return(0)
  mid_point <- (opt_min + opt_max) / 2
  half_range <- max((opt_max - opt_min) / 2, 0.001)
  return(abs(val - mid_point) / half_range)
}

# Menghitung lebar rentang optimal (makin lebar = makin tahan fluktuasi cuaca)
calc_bandwidth <- function(opt_min, opt_max) {
  if (is.na(opt_min) || is.na(opt_max)) return(0)
  return(max(opt_max - opt_min, 0))
}

# Mengonversi kategori main_uses menjadi bobot numerik utilitas komoditas
get_use_priority <- function(use_str) {
  if (is.na(use_str) || use_str == "") return(1)
  u <- tolower(use_str)
  if (grepl("cereal|food|grain|vegetable|fruit|staple", u)) return(4) # Pangan Utama
  if (grepl("industrial|beverage|oil|fiber|spices", u))    return(3) # Komersial/Industri
  if (grepl("forage|pasture|fodder", u))                  return(2) # Pakan Ternak
  return(1)                                                          # Hias / Lainnya
}

# 4. FAO TRAPEZOIDAL MEMBERSHIP FUNCTION (NUMERIK)
fao_membership <- function(val, abs_min, opt_min, opt_max, abs_max) {
  if (is.null(val) || is.na(val)) return(1.0)
  if (is.na(opt_min) || is.na(opt_max)) return(1.0)
  
  abs_min <- ifelse(is.na(abs_min) || abs_min >= opt_min, opt_min - 4.0, abs_min)
  abs_max <- ifelse(is.na(abs_max) || abs_max <= opt_max, opt_max + 5.0, abs_max)
  
  if (val < abs_min || val > abs_max) return(0.0)
  if (val >= opt_min && val <= opt_max) return(1.0)
  if (val >= abs_min && val < opt_min) return((val - abs_min) / (opt_min - abs_min))
  if (val > opt_max && val <= abs_max) return((abs_max - val) / (abs_max - opt_max))
  return(0.0)
}

# 5. LIGHT INTENSITY MEMBERSHIP FUNCTION (KATEGORIKAL)
fao_light_membership <- function(user_light, crop_light) {
  if (is.null(user_light) || is.na(user_light) || user_light == "") return(1.0)
  if (is.null(crop_light) || is.na(crop_light) || crop_light == "") return(1.0)
  
  u <- tolower(trimws(user_light))
  c <- tolower(trimws(crop_light))
  
  if (u == c || grepl(u, c, fixed = TRUE) || grepl(c, u, fixed = TRUE)) return(1.0)
  
  bright_terms <- c("very bright", "clear skies", "full sun", "bright")
  shade_terms  <- c("light shade", "cloudy skies", "partial shade", "shade")
  
  u_is_bright <- any(sapply(bright_terms, function(x) grepl(x, u)))
  c_is_bright <- any(sapply(bright_terms, function(x) grepl(x, c)))
  u_is_shade  <- any(sapply(shade_terms,  function(x) grepl(x, u)))
  c_is_shade  <- any(sapply(shade_terms,  function(x) grepl(x, c)))
  
  if (u_is_bright && c_is_bright) return(0.90)
  if (u_is_shade  && c_is_shade)  return(0.85)
  if ((u_is_bright && c_is_shade) || (u_is_shade && c_is_bright)) return(0.50)
  
  return(0.30)
}

# 6. ENGINE REKOMENDASI LENGKAP INTEGRASI TIE-BREAKER
recommend_pure_real_data <- function(user_temp  = NULL, 
                                     user_rain  = NULL, 
                                     user_ph    = NULL, 
                                     user_alt   = NULL, 
                                     user_light = NULL, 
                                     user_lat   = NULL, 
                                     top_n      = 3) {
  results <- list()
  
  for (i in 1:nrow(df_crops)) {
    row <- df_crops[i, ]
    
    # Extract numerical parameters
    t_opt_min <- get_num(row, "temp_opt_min", "Temp_Opt_Min")
    t_opt_max <- get_num(row, "Temp_Opt_Max", "temp_opt_max")
    t_abs_min <- get_num(row, "Temp_Abs_Min", "temp_abs_min")
    t_abs_max <- get_num(row, "Temp_Abs_Max", "temp_abs_max")
    
    r_opt_min <- get_num(row, "Rain_Opt_Min", "rain_opt_min")
    r_opt_max <- get_num(row, "Rain_Opt_Max", "rain_opt_max")
    r_abs_min <- get_num(row, "Rain_Abs_Min", "rain_abs_min")
    r_abs_max <- get_num(row, "Rain_Abs_Max", "rain_abs_max")
    
    p_opt_min <- get_num(row, "pH_Opt_Min", "ph_opt_min")
    p_opt_max <- get_num(row, "pH_Opt_Max", "ph_opt_max")
    p_abs_min <- get_num(row, "pH_Abs_Min", "ph_abs_min")
    p_abs_max <- get_num(row, "pH_Abs_Max", "ph_abs_max")
    
    a_opt_min <- get_num(row, "Alt_Opt_Min", "alt_opt_min")
    a_opt_max <- get_num(row, "Alt_Opt_Max", "alt_opt_max")
    a_abs_min <- get_num(row, "Alt_Abs_Min", "alt_abs_min")
    a_abs_max <- get_num(row, "Alt_Abs_Max", "alt_abs_max")
    
    l_opt_min <- get_num(row, "Lat_Opt_Min", "lat_opt_min")
    l_opt_max <- get_num(row, "Lat_Opt_Max", "lat_opt_max")
    l_abs_min <- get_num(row, "Lat_Abs_Min", "lat_abs_min")
    l_abs_max <- get_num(row, "Lat_Abs_Max", "lat_abs_max")
    
    crop_light <- get_val(row, "Light_Opt_Min", "light_opt", "Light_Opt_Max")
    main_uses  <- get_val(row, "Main_use_aggregated", "use.main", "main_uses")
    
    scores <- c()
    
    # 1. Temperature Suitability
    s_t <- if (!is.null(user_temp) && !is.na(user_temp)) {
      fao_membership(user_temp, t_abs_min, t_opt_min, t_opt_max, t_abs_max)
    } else { 1.0 }
    scores["temp"] <- s_t
    
    # 2. Rainfall Suitability
    s_r <- if (!is.null(user_rain) && !is.na(user_rain)) {
      fao_membership(user_rain, r_abs_min, r_opt_min, r_opt_max, r_abs_max)
    } else { 1.0 }
    scores["rain"] <- s_r
    
    # 3. pH Suitability
    s_p <- if (!is.null(user_ph) && !is.na(user_ph)) {
      fao_membership(user_ph, p_abs_min, p_opt_min, p_opt_max, p_abs_max)
    } else { 1.0 }
    scores["ph"] <- s_p
    
    # 4. Altitude Suitability
    s_a <- if (!is.null(user_alt) && !is.na(user_alt)) {
      fao_membership(user_alt, a_abs_min, a_opt_min, a_opt_max, a_abs_max)
    } else { 1.0 }
    scores["alt"] <- s_a
    
    # 5. Light Intensity Suitability
    s_l <- if (!is.null(user_light) && !is.na(user_light) && user_light != "") {
      fao_light_membership(user_light, crop_light)
    } else { 1.0 }
    scores["light"] <- s_l

    # 6. Latitude Suitability
    if (!is.null(user_lat) && !is.na(user_lat)) {
      user_lat_abs <- abs(user_lat)
      l_opt_min_f <- ifelse(is.na(l_opt_min), 0, l_opt_min)
      l_opt_max_f <- ifelse(is.na(l_opt_max), ifelse(is.na(l_abs_max), 35, l_abs_max), l_opt_max)
      l_abs_min_f <- ifelse(is.na(l_abs_min), 0, l_abs_min)
      l_abs_max_f <- ifelse(is.na(l_abs_max), l_opt_max_f + 10, l_abs_max)
      
      s_lat <- fao_membership(user_lat_abs, l_abs_min_f, l_opt_min_f, l_opt_max_f, l_abs_max_f)
      scores["lat"] <- s_lat
    } else {
      s_lat <- 1.0
    }
    
    # Geometric Mean LSI Score
    lsi <- if (length(scores) > 0) {
      (prod(scores)) ^ (1 / length(scores)) * 100.0
    } else { 100.0 }
    
    fao_class <- if (lsi >= 85.0) {
      "S1 (Highly Suitable)"
    } else if (lsi >= 60.0) {
      "S2 (Moderately Suitable)"
    } else if (lsi >= 40.0) {
      "S3 (Marginally Suitable)"
    } else {
      "N (Not Suitable)"
    }
    
    if (lsi > 0) {
      # Hitung indikator tie-breaker
      d_temp <- calc_opt_dist(user_temp, t_opt_min, t_opt_max)
      d_rain <- calc_opt_dist(user_rain, r_opt_min, r_opt_max)
      d_ph   <- calc_opt_dist(user_ph,   p_opt_min, p_opt_max)
      d_alt  <- calc_opt_dist(user_alt,  a_opt_min, a_opt_max)
      
      total_opt_dist <- d_temp + d_rain + d_ph + d_alt
      
      bw_temp <- calc_bandwidth(t_opt_min, t_opt_max)
      bw_rain <- calc_bandwidth(r_opt_min, r_opt_max)
      opt_bandwidth  <- bw_temp + (bw_rain / 100) # Normalisasi skala rain
      
      use_rank <- get_use_priority(main_uses)
      
      crop_code   <- get_val(row, "crop_code")
      species     <- get_val(row, "species")
      family      <- get_val(row, "Family_Clean", "Family", "family")
      life_form   <- get_val(row, "Life.form", "life_form")
      common_name <- get_val(row, "Common_names", "common_names")
      
      results[[length(results) + 1]] <- data.frame(
        crop_code      = ifelse(is.na(crop_code), "-", as.character(crop_code)),
        species        = ifelse(is.na(species), "-", species),
        family         = ifelse(is.na(family), "N/A", family),
        life_form      = ifelse(is.na(life_form), "-", life_form),
        lsi_raw        = lsi,              # Tie-breaker 1: Presisi desimal LSI
        total_opt_dist = total_opt_dist,  # Tie-breaker 2: Jarak ke titik tengah optimal
        opt_bandwidth  = opt_bandwidth,   # Tie-breaker 3: Lebar rentang toleransi
        use_rank       = use_rank,        # Tie-breaker 4: Utilitas komoditas pangan
        lsi_score      = round(lsi, 1),
        fao_class      = fao_class,
        s_temp_pct     = paste0(round(s_t * 100), "%"),
        s_rain_pct     = paste0(round(s_r * 100), "%"),
        s_ph_pct       = paste0(round(s_p * 100), "%"),
        s_alt_pct      = paste0(round(s_a * 100), "%"),
        s_light_pct    = paste0(round(s_l * 100), "%"),
        s_lat_pct      = paste0(round(s_lat * 100), "%"),
        crop_light_req = ifelse(is.na(crop_light), "unspecified", crop_light),
        main_uses      = ifelse(is.na(main_uses), "-", main_uses),
        common_names   = ifelse(is.na(common_name), "-", common_name),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }
  }
  
  if (length(results) == 0) return(data.frame())
  
  # 7. EXECUTE MULTI-TIER TIE-BREAKER SORTING
  res_df <- do.call(rbind, results) %>%
    arrange(
      desc(lsi_raw),      # Prioritas 1: Skor LSI paling presisi
      total_opt_dist,     # Prioritas 2: Paling mendekati pusat rentang optimal (paling stabil)
      desc(opt_bandwidth),# Prioritas 3: Rentang optimal paling luas (paling toleran)
      desc(use_rank),     # Prioritas 4: Tanaman pangan/komersial utama didahulukan
      species             # Prioritas 5: Alfabetis nama spesies
    ) %>%
    select(-lsi_raw, -total_opt_dist, -opt_bandwidth, -use_rank) %>% # Hapus kolom helper
    head(top_n)
  
  return(res_df)
}

# ==============================================================================
# EXECUTE TEST EVALUATION (Saring Top 3 Terbaik)
# ==============================================================================
cat("\n[User Input] Temp: 28°C | Rain: 1800 mm | pH: 6.5 | Alt: 450 m | Light: 'very bright' | Lat: -6.2°\n\n")

top_3_recs <- recommend_pure_real_data(
  user_temp  = 28, 
  user_rain  = 1800, 
  user_ph    = 6.5, 
  user_alt   = 450, 
  user_light = "very bright", 
  user_lat   = -6.2,
  top_n      = 100
)

print(top_3_recs %>% select(lsi_score, fao_class, species, family, s_temp_pct, s_rain_pct, s_ph_pct, s_alt_pct, s_light_pct, s_lat_pct, main_uses))
```

```{r}
cat(sprintf("-> Loading dataset: '%s'\n", dataset_file))

# 2. HELPER FUNCTIONS UNTUK RETRIEVAL KOLOM
get_val <- function(row, ...) {
  cols <- c(...)
  for (c in cols) {
    if (c %in% names(row) && !is.na(row[[c]]) && row[[c]] != "") {
      return(row[[c]])
    }
  }
  return(NA)
}

get_num <- function(row, ...) {
  v <- get_val(row, ...)
  if (is.na(v)) return(NA)
  return(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(v))))
}

# 3. FAO TRAPEZOIDAL MEMBERSHIP FUNCTION (NUMERIK)
fao_membership <- function(val, abs_min, opt_min, opt_max, abs_max) {
  if (is.null(val) || is.na(val)) return(1.0)
  if (is.na(opt_min) || is.na(opt_max)) return(1.0)
  
  abs_min <- ifelse(is.na(abs_min) || abs_min >= opt_min, opt_min - 4.0, abs_min)
  abs_max <- ifelse(is.na(abs_max) || abs_max <= opt_max, opt_max + 5.0, abs_max)
  
  if (val < abs_min || val > abs_max) return(0.0)
  if (val >= opt_min && val <= opt_max) return(1.0)
  if (val >= abs_min && val < opt_min) return((val - abs_min) / (opt_min - abs_min))
  if (val > opt_max && val <= abs_max) return((abs_max - val) / (abs_max - opt_max))
  return(0.0)
}

# 4. LIGHT INTENSITY MEMBERSHIP FUNCTION (KATEGORIKAL)
fao_light_membership <- function(user_light, crop_light) {
  if (is.null(user_light) || is.na(user_light) || user_light == "") return(1.0)
  if (is.null(crop_light) || is.na(crop_light) || crop_light == "") return(1.0)
  
  u <- tolower(trimws(user_light))
  c <- tolower(trimws(crop_light))
  
  if (u == c || grepl(u, c, fixed = TRUE) || grepl(c, u, fixed = TRUE)) return(1.0)
  
  bright_terms <- c("very bright", "clear skies", "full sun", "bright")
  shade_terms  <- c("light shade", "cloudy skies", "partial shade", "shade")
  
  u_is_bright <- any(sapply(bright_terms, function(x) grepl(x, u)))
  c_is_bright <- any(sapply(bright_terms, function(x) grepl(x, c)))
  u_is_shade  <- any(sapply(shade_terms,  function(x) grepl(x, u)))
  c_is_shade  <- any(sapply(shade_terms,  function(x) grepl(x, c)))
  
  if (u_is_bright && c_is_bright) return(0.90)
  if (u_is_shade  && c_is_shade)  return(0.85)
  if ((u_is_bright && c_is_shade) || (u_is_shade && c_is_bright)) return(0.50)
  
  return(0.30)
}

# 5. REKOMENDASI ENGINE DENGAN MULTI-CRITERIA TIE-BREAKER

                                     user_rain  = NULL,

    crop_light <- get_val(row, "Light_Opt_Min", "light_opt", "Light_Opt_Max")
    
    scores <- c()
    
    # 1. Temperature Suitability
    s_t <- if (!is.null(user_temp) && !is.na(user_temp)) {
      fao_membership(user_temp, t_abs_min, t_opt_min, t_opt_max, t_abs_max)
    } else { 1.0 }
    scores["temp"] <- s_t
    
    # 2. Rainfall Suitability
    s_r <- if (!is.null(user_rain) && !is.na(user_rain)) {
      fao_membership(user_rain, r_abs_min, r_opt_min, r_opt_max, r_abs_max)
    } else { 1.0 }
    scores["rain"] <- s_r
    
    # 3. pH Suitability
    s_p <- if (!is.null(user_ph) && !is.na(user_ph)) {
      fao_membership(user_ph, p_abs_min, p_opt_min, p_opt_max, p_abs_max)
    } else { 1.0 }

    # 4. Altitude Suitability
    s_a <- if (!is.null(user_alt) && !is.na(user_alt)) {
      fao_membership(user_alt, a_abs_min, a_opt_min, a_opt_max, a_abs_max)
    } else { 1.0 }
    scores["alt"] <- s_a

    s_l <- if (!is.null(user_light) && !is.na(user_light) && user_light != "") {

    } else { 1.0 }

    # 6. Latitude Suitability
    if (!is.null(user_lat) && !is.na(user_lat)) {
      user_lat_abs <- abs(user_lat)
      l_opt_min_f <- ifelse(is.na(l_opt_min), 0, l_opt_min)

      scores["lat"] <- s_lat
    } else {
      s_lat <- 1.0
    }
    
    # Geometric Mean LSI Score
    lsi <- if (length(scores) > 0) {
      (prod(scores)) ^ (1 / length(scores)) * 100.0
    } else { 100.0 }
    
    fao_class <- if (lsi >= 85.0) {
      "S1 (Highly Suitable)"
    } else if (lsi >= 60.0) {
      "S2 (Moderately Suitable)"
    } else if (lsi >= 40.0) {

    } else {

    if (lsi > 0) {
      crop_code   <- get_val(row, "crop_code")

        family         = ifelse(is.na(family), "N/A", family),
        life_form      = ifelse(is.na(life_form), "-", life_form),
        lsi_raw        = lsi,                        # Kriteria Tie-Breaker 1: Nilai presisi desimal
        lsi_score      = round(lsi, 1),              # Nilai tampilan persentase
        fao_class      = fao_class,
        s_temp_pct     = paste0(round(s_t * 100), "%"),
        s_rain_pct     = paste0(round(s_r * 100), "%"),
        s_ph_pct       = paste0(round(s_p * 100), "%"),

        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }
  }

  res_df <- do.call(rbind, results) %>%
    arrange(
      desc(lsi_raw),   # Prioritas 1: Skor presisi murni sebelum rounding
      species          # Prioritas 2: Alfabetis spesies jika lsi_raw identik
    ) %>%
    select(-lsi_raw) %>%
    head(top_n)
  
  return(res_df)
}
```
